title: Apps
intro: Connect apps over MCP (Model Context Protocol) — mail, calendar, design tools, databases… — like in Claude Desktop. Agents use an app only if you allow it; tools that change things wait for your approval, and every call is in the audit log.

empty.title: No apps yet
empty.hint: Add an MCP server: a local program (e.g. npx …) or a remote address. You can also paste a config snippet from a README or import the servers you set up in Claude Desktop.

detail.enabledHint: When off, no agent can use this app.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete the app "{{name}}"? Agents lose access; the audit log keeps its entries.
detail.signInHint: Opens the app's sign-in page in your browser; Agentbits stores the token encrypted on this computer. Only sign in to servers you trust, and check that the page that opens belongs to the service you expect before entering your password.

tools.none: No tools listed yet — click "Connect & list tools".
tools.policyHint: Read-only tools run automatically by default; everything else waits for your approval in the bottom-left panel. The app reports these hints itself — tighten them if you're not sure.

access.hint: Agents allowed to use this app (all its non-blocked tools, with the policies above). Nobody has access by default.

form.name: Name
form.description: What is it for? (agents see this)
form.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Company mailbox: read and draft replies
form.envHint: API keys and tokens go here. Values are stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.oauth: Sign in with OAuth in the browser
form.oauthHint: For servers that ask you to log in (most hosted apps).
form.stdioWarning: Agentbits runs this command on your computer with your user's rights. Only add servers you trust (official ones or from a source you know). Many need Node.js (npx) or uv (uvx) installed.

import.jsonHint: Paste the JSON from a README or another app — e.g. {"mcpServers": {"name": {"command": "npx", "args": […]}}}.
import.secretsNote: Values of environment variables and headers are stored encrypted.

agent.title: Apps
agent.desc: Connected apps (MCP) this agent may use. Policies per tool are set in Organization → Apps.
